<!-- isms:begin id=overview -->

## Document Overview {#sec-overview}

This Change Management Policy establishes how changes to {{< var environment_name >}}s
within the scope of {{< var organisation >}}'s {{< var isms_name >}} are proposed, assessed,
approved and recorded, so that changes do not undermine the confidentiality, integrity or
availability of the information those environments hold.

<!-- isms:end id=overview -->

<!-- isms:begin id=scope -->

## Document Scope {#sec-scope}

This policy applies to all changes affecting the infrastructure, applications, services and
documented information that support the {{< var environment_abbr >}}s, including changes to
this {{< var isms_name >}} itself.

<!-- isms:end id=scope -->

<!-- isms:begin id=classification hint="Define your own change categories if they differ from significant/minor." -->

## Change Categories {#sec-classification}

Changes shall be categorised before assessment:

- **Significant change:** a change that alters the risk profile of an environment, affects
  the scope of the {{< var isms_name >}}, or changes a mandatory requirement in a controlled
  document. Significant changes shall be approved by the
  {{< var roles.governance_body >}}.
- **Minor change:** any other change. Minor changes may be approved by the
  {{< var roles.ig_lead >}} or a delegate.

<!-- isms:end id=classification -->

<!-- isms:begin id=assessment -->

## Assessment and Approval {#sec-assessment}

- Every change shall have an identified requester and an identified approver, and the two
  shall not be the same person.
- Every significant change shall be risk assessed before approval, and the assessment shall
  be recorded.
- Changes shall be recorded such that the change, its rationale, its approver and its date
  of approval can be reconstructed after the fact.
- Emergency changes may be implemented before approval where a delay would increase risk,
  but shall be recorded and retrospectively approved at the next meeting of the
  {{< var roles.governance_body >}}.

<!-- isms:end id=assessment -->

<!-- isms:begin id=review -->

## Review of Controlled Documents {#sec-review}

Controlled documents shall be reviewed at least once every review period stated in their
document control table. A review shall be recorded even where it results in no change.

<!-- isms:end id=review -->
